en.text: Tesla Energy deployed 6.5 GWh of storage in Q3 2022. The demand for grid-scale batteries is exploding.
en.context: Tesla energy storage quarterly deployment data

zh.text: 特斯拉能源在2022年第三季度部署了6.5 GWh储能。对电网级电池的需求正在爆炸式增长。
zh.context: 特斯拉储能部署季度数据

en.text: The world needs to transition to sustainable energy. It's not optional. Fossil fuels will eventually run out.

zh.text: 世界需要向可持续能源转型。这不是可选的。化石燃料最终会耗尽。
zh.context: 关于可持续能源转型的评论

en.text: Megapack is the future of grid storage. One Megapack can power 3,000 homes for a day. We need thousands of them.
en.context: Megapack product introduction and scale needs

zh.text: Megapack是电网储能的未来。一个Megapack可以为3000户家庭供电一天。我们需要成千上万个。
zh.context: Megapack产品介绍和规模需求

en.text: Solar + Powerwall + Megapack = complete energy independence for homes and businesses. The math works.
en.context: Tesla energy product suite value proposition

zh.text: 太阳能+Powerwall+Megapack=家庭和企业的完全能源独立。算下来是可行的。
zh.context: 特斯拉能源产品组合的价值主张

en.text: Tesla Energy is now a multi-billion dollar business on its own. The energy transition is the biggest opportunity in history.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源现在本身就是一个数十亿美元的业务。能源转型是历史上最大的机遇。
zh.context: 特斯拉能源业务规模里程碑

en.text: Powerwall 3 is here. 3x the power output, easier installation, and it integrates seamlessly with solar.

zh.text: Powerwall 3来了。3倍的功率输出，更简单的安装，与太阳能无缝集成。
zh.context: Powerwall 3发布

en.text: The Lathrop Megafactory is producing 1 Megapack per hour. The largest battery factory in the world.

zh.text: Lathrop Megafactory每小时生产1个Megapack。世界上最大的电池工厂。
zh.context: Lathrop工厂产能里程碑

en.text: Tesla Energy deployed 14.7 GWh of storage in 2023. That's more than the entire industry did 2 years ago.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源在2023年部署了14.7 GWh储能。这比整个行业两年前的总量还多。
zh.context: 2023年储能部署年度数据

en.text: Solar roofs are now cheaper than regular roofs in most markets. The payback period is under 5 years.

zh.text: 太阳能屋顶在大多数市场现在比普通屋顶更便宜。回本周期不到5年。
zh.context: 太阳能屋顶经济性评论

en.text: The grid needs massive storage to handle renewable energy intermittency. Tesla Megapack is the answer.

zh.text: 电网需要大规模储能来应对可再生能源的间歇性。特斯拉Megapack就是答案。
zh.context: 关于电网储能需求的评论

en.text: Tesla Energy revenue grew 100% year over year. The energy business will eventually be bigger than the car business.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源收入同比增长100%。能源业务最终将比汽车业务更大。
zh.context: 特斯拉能源收入增长里程碑

en.text: We need to mine more lithium for batteries. But we also need to recycle. Tesla's battery recycling rate is now over 90%.
en.context: Commentary on lithium mining and battery recycling

zh.text: 我们需要开采更多锂来制造电池。但我们也需要回收。特斯拉的电池回收率现在超过90%。
zh.context: 关于锂矿开采和电池回收的评论

en.text: Tesla Energy deployed 31.4 GWh in 2024. The growth rate is exponential. Grid storage is the new oil.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源在2024年部署了31.4 GWh。增长率是指数级的。电网储能是新的石油。
zh.context: 2024年储能部署数据

en.text: A sustainable energy future requires solar, wind, batteries, and nuclear. All of the above, not just one.
en.context: Commentary on diversified clean energy mix

zh.text: 可持续能源的未来需要太阳能、风能、电池和核能。以上全部，而不是只选其一。
zh.context: 关于多元化清洁能源组合的评论

en.text: Tesla's Shanghai Megafactory is now producing Megapacks at scale. China's energy storage market is massive.
en.context: Shanghai energy storage factory production start

zh.text: 特斯拉上海Megafactory现在正在大规模生产Megapack。中国的储能市场是巨大的。
zh.context: 上海储能工厂投产

en.text: Tesla Energy is building the world's largest battery factory in Shanghai. 40 GWh annual capacity. Unprecedented scale.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源正在上海建造世界上最大的电池工厂。年产能40 GWh。前所未有的规模。
zh.context: 上海电池工厂规模公布

en.text: Powerwall installations have surpassed 1 million units worldwide. Home energy storage is going mainstream.

zh.text: Powerwall全球安装量已超过100万台。家庭储能正在成为主流。
zh.context: Powerwall安装里程碑

en.text: The world spent $500B on energy storage in 2025. Tesla captured 25% of that market. We're just getting started.
en.context: Global energy storage market size and Tesla share

zh.text: 2025年世界在储能上花费了5000亿美元。特斯拉占据了25%的市场份额。我们才刚刚开始。
zh.context: 全球储能市场规模和特斯拉份额

en.text: Every home should have solar panels and a Powerwall. Energy independence is a basic right.

zh.text: 每个家庭都应该有太阳能板和Powerwall。能源独立是一项基本权利。
zh.context: 关于家庭能源独立的评论

en.text: Tesla Energy deployed 50 GWh in 2025. We are now the largest energy storage company in the world by a wide margin.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源在2025年部署了50 GWh。我们现在以巨大优势成为世界上最大的储能公司。
zh.context: 2025年储能部署数据

en.text: The transition to sustainable energy is accelerating faster than anyone predicted. Tesla is at the center of it.

zh.text: 向可持续能源的转型正在以超出任何人预测的速度加速。特斯拉正处于中心位置。
zh.context: 关于能源转型加速的评论

en.text: Megapack 3 announced. 2x the energy density, 50% lower cost. Grid storage just got a massive upgrade.

zh.text: Megapack 3发布。2倍的能量密度，50%更低的成本。电网储能刚刚获得巨大升级。
zh.context: Megapack 3发布

en.text: Nuclear energy is essential for the sustainable energy transition. We should not shut down existing nuclear plants.
en.context: Supporting nuclear energy's role in energy transition

zh.text: 核能对可持续能源转型至关重要。我们不应该关闭现有的核电站。
zh.context: 支持核能在能源转型中的角色

en.text: Tesla's new solar panel efficiency record: 24.5%. We're pushing the limits of what's physically possible.

zh.text: 特斯拉新的太阳能板效率纪录：24.5%。我们正在突破物理极限。
zh.context: 太阳能板效率突破

en.text: Tesla Energy will be a $100B revenue business by 2028. The energy transition is the biggest economic opportunity in human history.

zh.text: 特斯拉能源到2028年将成为一个收入1000亿美元的业务。能源转型是人类历史上最大的经济机遇。
zh.context: 特斯拉能源业务收入预测
